author: Joshua Fluke
description:
Walmart employees are apparently doing Facebook skits, chants, karaoke, “work besties” videos, break-room tours, product promotions and corporate team-building content now.

And some of these employees have been there for 25 or 30 years.

In this video, we’re going through some of the strangest Walmart employee social-media posts I could find and asking a very simple question:

Why are we doing this to grown adults?

One Walmart proudly shows off a renovated employee break room containing basic tables, chairs, a refrigerator and cubbies.

Another celebrates an employee with 30 years of service.

Others have employees dancing, acting in skits, singing karaoke, chanting Walmart, promoting Tap to Pay, advertising deli food and participating in “Fun Friday” teamwork games for social media.

There are videos where employees look like they would rather be anywhere else.

There are stores filming skits while actual customers are standing in line.

title: COMPANIES ARE MAKING EMPLOYEES DO THIS NOW?!
